caption: The drawing depicts a lidded ceramic vessel, such as a soup tureen, placed centrally on a lightly colored, off-white background. The vessel has a rounded body with two side handles, and a lid topped by a small rounded knob. The main body and lid are decorated with symmetrical floral and leaf motifs in bright colors: blue, green, yellow, orange, and red. Around the middle of the lid is a band with alternating yellow diamond and blue triangle patterns, bordered by thinner yellow and blue lines. The handle areas are colored in a pale brown or beige. The floral motifs include blue stems, red and orange bulbous flowers, clusters of small green leaves, and yellow and green leaf forms distributed evenly across the surface. The bottom edge of the vessel is trimmed with thin bands of blue and orange. The vessel is composed with clear outlines and shading, and is centered within a faint rectangular guideline drawn on the background, with the words “ACTUAL SIZE” inscribed near the bottom center of the image.
title: Sugar Bowl
